blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Iloilo City government is strengthening security measures in schools following the fatal shooting at Banga National High School in South Cotabato. Mayor Raisa Treñas said the shooting in Banga on Friday (Sept. 18) was another reminder that local authorities cannot afford to take student safety for granted, even if the incident happened hundreds of kilometers from Iloilo. “I am deeply saddened and alarmed by the tragic shooting incident at Banga National High School in South Cotabato, which claimed the lives of students and left others injured,” Treñas said in a statement on Friday. “On behalf of […]...
